declarations.text: I am filled with spiritual boldness, and I declare God's truth with confidence!
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.

declarations.text: I am growing in wisdom and revelation as I seek the Lord!
declarations.bibleVerseText: I keep asking that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you the Spirit of wisdom and revelation, so that you may know him better.

declarations.text: I am spiritually disciplined, and I remain steadfast in my faith!
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

declarations.text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

declarations.text: I am divinely protected and blessed in all circumstances.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue which rises against you in judgment You shall condemn.

declarations.text: God has given me a spirit of power, love, and sound mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

declarations.text: My God abundantly supplies every need from His unlimited riches.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And my God shall supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: By the stripes of Jesus, I am completely healed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By His stripes we are healed.

declarations.text: I trust wholeheartedly in the Lord who directs my paths.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.

declarations.text: The Lord has made me the head and never the tail.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the Lord will make you the head and not the tail; you shall be above only, and not be beneath.

declarations.text: The Lord my God goes with me making me strong and courageous.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.

declarations.text: In all things, I am more than a conqueror through Him who loves me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yet in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

declarations.text: I hold firmly to my faith because God always keeps His promises.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.

declarations.text: I dwell in the secret place of God under His protective shadow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: God is working all things together for my good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are called according to His purpose.

declarations.text: I seek first the kingdom of God, and everything I need is provided.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things shall be added to you.

declarations.text: This is the day the Lord made and I rejoice with gladness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is the day the Lord has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

declarations.text: I trample every enemy under my feet with divine authority.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You shall tread upon the lion and the cobra, the young lion and the serpent you shall trample underfoot.

declarations.text: God satisfies me with long life and shows me His salvation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With long life I will satisfy him, and show him My salvation.

declarations.text: I am completely protected under God's mighty shield of favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Behold, I give you the authority to trample on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

declarations.text: I persevere joyfully. God's blessing comes at the perfect time.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us not grow weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

declarations.text: God is making a way for me with perfect wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.

declarations.text: My youth is renewed like eagles and I overflow with strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagles.

declarations.text: I declare the blood of Jesus broke every chain, reversed every curse, and made my freedom final.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law.

declarations.text: His blood didnt just heal me it erased what doctors couldnt explain and made wholeness my new normal.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace and be healed.

declarations.text: I stand healed His blood paid in full for every part of me to be restored, strong, and thriving.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By His wounds we are healed.

declarations.text: I speak the blood over my mind confusion flees, clarity floods in, and peace rules my thoughts.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The mind governed by the Spirit is life and peace.

declarations.text: I am fully forgiven, forever clean, and boldly accepted all because the blood settled my case in heaven.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins.

declarations.text: I don't beg for access. I walk in because His blood tore the veil and made me welcome.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus.

declarations.text: Shame can't speak His blood declared me righteous, fearless, and bold before God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us then approach Gods throne of grace with confidence.

declarations.text: Every lie of guilt and condemnation is silenced His blood speaks innocence louder than my past.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: His blood didnt just forgive me it crushed the enemys plan and made me victorious forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.

declarations.text: I am royalty now His blood made me a child of the King and heir of everything He promised.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We are Gods children. Then we are heirs.

declarations.text: The blood of Jesus rewrote my identity redeemed, chosen, and sealed forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You who once were far off have been brought near by the blood of Christ.

declarations.text: His blood didnt whisper it roared mercy over judgment and wrote peace into my soul.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

declarations.text: I am free, clean, whole, and fearless not because I earned it, but because His blood secured it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You were redeemed with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish.

declarations.text: I shout the Name of Jesus hell shakes, chains snap, and every demon flees.
declarations.bibleVerseText: At the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth.

declarations.text: When. I speak the Name of Jesus, healing and miracles erupt nothing can stand against it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: His name, by faith in his name, has made this man strong.

declarations.text: By the Name of Jesus, I command sickness to bow health flows like a river through me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.

declarations.text: I speak life in Jesus' Name, dead things rise and destinies awaken.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lazarus, come forth!

declarations.text: I declare the darkness broken Jesus' Name pierces like lightning and floods with light.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.

declarations.text: At the sound of His Name, chains fall, prisons shake, and freedom floods in.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

declarations.text: I release divine peace chaos obeys when Jesus speaks through me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Peace, be still. And the wind ceased.

declarations.text: I confess the Name of Jesus hells grip breaks, and heaven roars back in response.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.

declarations.text: Provision flows, doors fly open, and favor surrounds me because I carry His Name.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Ask in my name, and you will receive.

declarations.text: I speak the Name of Jesus with power and walk in His divine authority.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

declarations.text: I speak revival in Jesus' Name and awaken hearts with His love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit.

declarations.text: I speak truth in Jesus' Name and His light shines through me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Is not my word like fire, declares the Lord.

declarations.text: When I declare Jesus' Name, heaven backs my words with His power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you.

declarations.text: I rise unshaken because Jesus' Name is my anchor and strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken.

declarations.text: I declare my body must align with divine health and wholeness.
I declare every cell in my body functions perfectly as God intended.
I declare that my body is renewed, restored, and filled with life.
I declare that God’s healing power flows through every part of me.
I declare my heart beats strong and steady, aligned with God’s strength.
I declare my mind is clear, my spirit is strong, and my body is whole.
I declare my immune system is fortified, healthy, and resilient.
I declare my muscles, bones, and joints are aligned with vitality and strength.
I declare my digestive system is healthy, strong, and perfectly functioning.
I declare my lungs are filled with the breath of life, bringing me energy and peace.
I declare that God’s peace flows through my mind and brings healing to my body.
I declare every organ is functioning in perfect harmony, aligned with God’s design.
I declare my nervous system is calm, balanced, and perfectly aligned.
I declare that my body is continually renewed and strengthened by God’s love.
I declare that I am vibrant, energetic, and full of life as God intended.
In Jesus' name, my body is healed, for He has paid the price for my health.
In Jesus' name, I conquer every disease, as His power flows through me.
In Jesus' name, I stand strong and healthy, redeemed from all sickness.
In Jesus' name, every part of my body is restored to perfect health.
In Jesus' name, no illness can remain in me, for His sacrifice made me whole.
In Jesus' name, I declare my immune system strong and disease-free.
In Jesus' name, my body is cleansed, renewed, and protected from all harm.
In Jesus' name, every cell in my body is revitalized and filled with life.
In Jesus' name, I am free from pain and filled with divine health.
In Jesus' name, I am whole, as He has defeated every illness on my behalf.
In Jesus' name, I receive complete healing and strength in every organ.
I am completely restored, my body perfectly renewed by His mighty power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By his wounds we are healed.

declarations.text: Heaven's strength and Holy Spirit vitality infuse every part of my body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of his Spirit who lives in you.

declarations.text: Christ's resurrection life overflows through me, anchoring my body in supernatural strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.

declarations.text: By Christ's stripes, I am completely restored! Supernatural wellness reigns in my body!
declarations.bibleVerseText: By his wounds we are healed.

declarations.text: His restorative power causes me to vibrate with radical renewal in every way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give you back your health and heal your wounds, says the Lord.

declarations.text: Christ sealed my restoration with His blood and power - I am unshakably renewed!
declarations.bibleVerseText: A peaceful heart leads to a healthy body.

declarations.text: His Spirit fills me with power and I radiate supernatural wellness everywhere!
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit.

declarations.text: Christ's finished work pulses through me, making me whole, restored, and unshakable!
declarations.bibleVerseText: That you are as healthy in body as you are strong in spirit.

declarations.text: His Word floods my body with life - I am restored, thriving, and completely alive!
declarations.bibleVerseText: He sent out his word and healed them.

declarations.text: I am the Lord who heals you. Every sickness, every pain, every disease must bow to My name.
In Jesus' name, By My stripes, you are healed. My resurrection power is flooding your body with full restoration.
In Jesus' name, I am renewing your strength like the eagles. You will run with energy and soar with endurance.
I came so you would have life real, rich, unstoppable life. My vitality is filling you now.
Do not fear. I am with you. I am reviving every weary place and restoring your body with My strength.
In Jesus' name, divine health surrounds you completely. My healing flows through every cell of your body.
I send My Word and it heals you. From the inside out, I am making you whole.
I am breathing new life into your bones, your organs, your heart everything is being revived in My name.
Your body is My holy temple. I've declared it strong, vibrant, and filled with My Spirit.
I am the resurrection and the life. What looks dead, I am bringing back to full, radiant life.
The Lord's protection surrounds me completely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

declarations.text: I dwell in the secret place of the Most High.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: The Lord is my impenetrable shield and faithful protector in everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

declarations.text: Angels guard me in all my ways by God's divine command.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: My fortress in God is unshakeable and provides perfect security always.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

declarations.text: Divine strength flows through me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.

declarations.text: I am mighty in the Lord's power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are awesome, O God, in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!

declarations.text: Mountains move at my faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea, though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.

declarations.text: With God. I can scale any wall.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

declarations.text: Victory is mine in every battle.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May we shout for joy over your victory and lift up our banners in the name of our God.

declarations.text: Perfect peace guards my heart and mind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

declarations.text: I rest in divine tranquility.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

declarations.text: Still waters restore my soul daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters.

declarations.text: My sleep is sweet and peaceful.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

declarations.text: Serenity flows through every cell of my being.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child I am content.

declarations.text: My cup overflows with blessings.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

declarations.text: I lack nothing in God's abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

declarations.text: Divine provision meets every need.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.

declarations.text: Goodness and mercy pursue me relentlessly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

declarations.text: Heaven's resources are mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

declarations.text: Divine healing flows through me now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases.

declarations.text: Every cell in my body vibrates with health.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He sent out his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

declarations.text: I am restored to perfect wholeness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lord my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.

declarations.text: Healing springs forth speedily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

declarations.text: My youth is renewed like the eagle's.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

declarations.text: Joy springs eternal in my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

declarations.text: My mouth is filled with praise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.

declarations.text: I radiate divine joy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.

declarations.text: Thanksgiving overflows from my soul.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

declarations.text: I dance with holy delight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with timbrel and harp.

declarations.text: Divine wisdom illuminates my path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

declarations.text: I hear God's voice clearly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if only you would hear his voice.

declarations.text: My steps are ordered by the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and He delights in his way.

declarations.text: Perfect guidance leads me always.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.

declarations.text: I walk in divine revelation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.

declarations.text: Through God we push back our enemies.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.

declarations.text: Every chain is broken.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He brought them out of darkness, the utter darkness, and broke away their chains.

declarations.text: Freedom is my inheritance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

declarations.text: I triumph over every enemy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

declarations.text: Deliverance comes swiftly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

declarations.text: My faith moves mountains.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

declarations.text: I trust completely in divine timing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My times are in your hands; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, from those who pursue me.

declarations.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

declarations.text: My confidence is unshakeable.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.

declarations.text: I walk by faith, not by sight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I have always been mindful of your unfailing love and have lived in reliance on your faithfulness.

declarations.text: Unfailing love surrounds me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the Lord's unfailing love surrounds the one who trusts in him.

declarations.text: I am the beloved of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

declarations.text: Divine favor opens every door.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely, Lord, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: Mercy triumphs in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But from everlasting to everlasting the Lord's love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children's children.

declarations.text: I am crowned with lovingkindness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion.

declarations.text: I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

declarations.text: Royal blood flows through my veins.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I said, 'You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.'

declarations.text: I am God's masterpiece.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother's womb. I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

declarations.text: Purpose and destiny guide my steps.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will vindicate me; your love, Lord, endures forever do not abandon the works of your hands.

declarations.text: I am chosen and appointed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.

declarations.text: Divine light illuminates my darkness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You, Lord, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

declarations.text: I shine with heaven's glory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.

declarations.text: Truth makes me free.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set my heart on your laws.

declarations.text: I walk in the light.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, Lord.

declarations.text: Revelation flows to me freely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

declarations.text: The Lord rewards me according to my righteousness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

declarations.text: Holiness adorns my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your statutes, Lord, stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days.

declarations.text: I walk in divine justice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He will make your righteous reward shine like the dawn, your vindication like the noonday sun.

declarations.text: My heart is pure before God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.

declarations.text: I stand blameless and complete.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

declarations.text: The Lord is faithful to all his promises.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is trustworthy in all he promises and faithful in all he does.

declarations.text: I inherit the kingdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy peace and prosperity.

declarations.text: The Lord withholds no good thing from those who walk uprightly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

declarations.text: I possess the land of promise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For those who are evil will be destroyed, but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.

declarations.text: Heaven's treasures are mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

declarations.text: I dwell in God's presence continually.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely the righteous will praise your name, and the upright will live in your presence.

declarations.text: The Holy Spirit lives in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.

declarations.text: I commune with the Divine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God. My soul thirsts for God, for the living God.

declarations.text: God's presence goes before me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You hem me in behind and before, and you lay your hand upon me.

declarations.text: I am never alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence? If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.

declarations.text: I exercise divine authority.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet.

declarations.text: Power belongs to God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: Power belongs to you, God.

declarations.text: The king rejoices in God's strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The king rejoices in your strength, Lord. How great is his joy in the victories you give!

declarations.text: Dominion is my birthright.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet: all flocks and herds, and the animals of the wild, the birds in the sky, and the fish in the sea.

declarations.text: I speak and it is established.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.

declarations.text: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

declarations.text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

declarations.text: I lift my eyes to the mountains; my help comes from the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I lift up my eyes to the mountains where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.

declarations.text: The Lord watches over my coming and going, now and forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

declarations.text: I will be still and know that He is God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He says, 'Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'

declarations.text: The Lord is my light and salvation, I will not fear.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my light and my salvation whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life of whom shall I be afraid?

declarations.text: God is my refuge and strength, always ready to help in times of trouble.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

declarations.text: I am like a tree planted by water, yielding fruit in every season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither whatever they do prospers.

declarations.text: The Lord forgives all my sins and heals all my diseases.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases.

declarations.text: The Lord redeems my life and crowns me with love and compassion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion.

declarations.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

declarations.text: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

declarations.text: I have set the Lord always before me; I shall not be moved.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I keep my eyes always on the Lord. With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

declarations.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and all that is within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

declarations.text: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

declarations.text: I am made in God's perfect image.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

declarations.text: God's blessing makes me fruitful and multiplies my success.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God blessed them and said to them, 'Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it.'

declarations.text: God gives me dominion through His authority.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then God said, 'Let us make mankind in our image, in our likeness, so that they may rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky.'

declarations.text: Everything God made in me is very good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.

declarations.text: God breathed His life into me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.

declarations.text: I walk with God in perfect fellowship.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day.

declarations.text: God's covenant with me is everlasting.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you.

declarations.text: Nothing is too hard for the Lord in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Is anything too hard for the Lord? I will return to you at the appointed time next year, and Sarah will have a son.

declarations.text: God provides a ram in my wilderness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Abraham looked up and there in a thicket he saw a ram caught by its horns. He went over and took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering instead of his son.

declarations.text: I am blessed to be a blessing to nations.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.

declarations.text: The Lord directs my steps perfectly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord had said to Abram, 'Go from your country, your people and your father's household to the land I will show you.'

declarations.text: God meant it for my good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.

declarations.text: I prevail and receive a new name.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome.

declarations.text: My descendants are as numerous as the stars.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Look up at the sky and count the stars if indeed you can count them. So shall your offspring be.

declarations.text: God remembers His covenant with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and the livestock that were with him in the ark.

declarations.text: I find favor in God's eyes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.

declarations.text: The Lord is my shield and great reward.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.

declarations.text: God turns evil intentions for my good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good.

declarations.text: I am fruitful in the land of my affliction.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The second son he named Ephraim and said, 'It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering.'

declarations.text: God goes before me and behind me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land.

declarations.text: I AM sends me with power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God said to Moses, 'I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: I AM has sent me to you.'

declarations.text: God fights my battles while. I stay still.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

declarations.text: My impossible seas part before me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord drove the sea back with a strong east wind all that night and turned it into dry land. The waters were divided.

declarations.text: I am delivered by the mighty hand of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians. I will free you from being slaves to them, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm.

declarations.text: The Lord is my healer.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I am the Lord, who heals you.

declarations.text: God's presence goes with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.

declarations.text: I am God's treasured possession.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession.

declarations.text: My enemies flee before the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.

declarations.text: God provides manna in my wilderness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord said to Moses, 'I will rain down bread from heaven for you.'

declarations.text: I am covered by the blood of the Lamb.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blood will be a sign for you on the houses where you are, and when I see the blood, I will pass over you.

declarations.text: God makes a way where there is no way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.

declarations.text: The glory of the Lord fills my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

declarations.text: I am set free from every bondage.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have seen the misery of my people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their slave drivers, and I am concerned about their suffering.

declarations.text: God turns my bitter waters sweet.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Moses cried out to the Lord, and the Lord showed him a piece of wood. He threw it into the water, and the water became fit to drink.

declarations.text: I overcome by the power of God's rod.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Take this staff in your hand so you can perform the signs with it.

declarations.text: The Lord is my banner of victory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Moses built an altar and called it The Lord is my Banner.

declarations.text: I speak face to face with God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord would speak to Moses face to face, as one speaks to a friend.

declarations.text: God's glory transforms my face.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the Lord.

declarations.text: I am sanctified and set apart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the Lord your God.

declarations.text: The pillar of fire guides my night.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By day the Lord went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light.

declarations.text: I am holy because God is holy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be holy because I, the Lord your God, am holy.

declarations.text: I am set apart for God's purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are to be holy to me because I, the Lord, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.

declarations.text: My worship is a sweet aroma to God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It is a burnt offering, a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the Lord.

declarations.text: I walk in God's statutes and live.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Keep my decrees and laws, for the person who obeys them will live by them. I am the Lord.

declarations.text: God dwells among me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will put my dwelling place among you, and I will not abhor you. I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

declarations.text: I am redeemed and restored.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If they will confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors, then I will remember my covenant.

declarations.text: My land yields abundant increase.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops and the trees their fruit.

declarations.text: I eat and am satisfied in God's provision.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will eat all the food you want and live in safety in your land.

declarations.text: Peace reigns in my territory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid.

declarations.text: I belong to the Lord completely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Israelites are my servants. They are my servants whom I brought out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

declarations.text: My offerings are accepted before God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When you sacrifice a fellowship offering to the Lord, sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

declarations.text: I am cleansed and made pure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He shall purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean.

declarations.text: God's glory fills my sanctuary.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Moses and Aaron then went into the tent of meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.

declarations.text: I love my neighbor as myself.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against anyone among your people, but love your neighbor as yourself.

declarations.text: My years are blessed with jubilee.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you.

declarations.text: The Lord blesses me and keeps me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.

declarations.text: God's face shines upon me with grace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.

declarations.text: The Lord gives me His peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.

declarations.text: God's name is placed upon me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So they will put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.

declarations.text: The cloud of God directs my journey.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whenever the cloud lifted from above the tent, the Israelites set out; wherever the cloud settled, the Israelites encamped.

declarations.text: God is not a man that He should lie.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is not human, that he should lie, not a human being, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act?

declarations.text: What God blesses cannot be cursed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How can I curse those whom God has not cursed? How can I denounce those whom the Lord has not denounced?

declarations.text: I am strong as a lion rising up.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion that does not rest till it devours its prey.

declarations.text: My strength is renewed at the rock.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He brought water out of the rock for them; water gushed out, and the community and their livestock drank.

declarations.text: God fights for me against my enemies.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord your God, who is going before you, will fight for you, as he did for you in Egypt.

declarations.text: I have a different spirit and follow God fully.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land.

declarations.text: The Lord's power is displayed in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now may the Lord's strength be displayed, just as you have declared.

declarations.text: I am filled with the Spirit of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and spoke with him, and he took some of the power of the Spirit that was on him.

declarations.text: God turns curses into blessings for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: However, the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you.

declarations.text: I inherit the promised land.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The land I am giving the Israelites will be divided among them as an inheritance.

declarations.text: I love the Lord with all my heart, soul, and strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.

declarations.text: God writes His words on my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: These commandments that I give you today are to be on your hearts. Impress them on your children.

declarations.text: I am the head and not the tail.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the Lord your God.

declarations.text: I am blessed in the city and the field.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

declarations.text: My basket and kneading trough are blessed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your basket and your kneading trough will be blessed.

declarations.text: I am blessed coming in and going out.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.

declarations.text: My enemies flee before me seven ways.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you. They will come at you from one direction but flee from you in seven.

declarations.text: The Lord establishes me as His holy people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will establish you as his holy people, as he promised you on oath.

declarations.text: I lend and do not borrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

declarations.text: God fights for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord your God will fight for you; you need only to be still.

declarations.text: I am strong and courageous.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the Lord your God goes with you.

declarations.text: The eternal God is my refuge.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms.

declarations.text: I choose life and blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live.

declarations.text: God circumcises my heart to love Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, so that you may love him.

declarations.text: The Lord rejoices over me with singing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will again delight in you and make you prosperous, just as he delighted in your ancestors.

declarations.text: God makes me strong and courageous.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

declarations.text: God is with me wherever I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

declarations.text: God's word prospers me as I meditate on it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.

declarations.text: Every place my foot treads is mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

declarations.text: No one can stand against me all my days.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life.

declarations.text: My walls of Jericho fall down.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When the trumpets sounded, the army shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the men gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed.

declarations.text: The sun stands still for my victory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.

declarations.text: I choose to serve the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord.

declarations.text: The Lord fights my battles.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord your God will fight for you, just as he promised.

declarations.text: I cross over into my promised land.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them.

declarations.text: Not one good promise fails.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Not one of all the Lord's good promises to Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.

declarations.text: I am sanctified for tomorrow's miracle.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you.

declarations.text: The Spirit of the Lord comes upon me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on him, and he became Israel's judge.

declarations.text: God crushes my enemies before me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord routed Sisera with all his chariots and all his troops by the sword.

declarations.text: I am mighty in God's strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is with you, mighty warrior.

declarations.text: My weakness becomes God's strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But Lord, how can I save Israel? My clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my family.

declarations.text: God gives me victory with few.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord said to Gideon, 'With the three hundred men that lapped I will save you and give the Midianites into your hands.'

declarations.text: The Lord goes before me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When I blow my trumpet, then blow your trumpets around the entire camp and shout, 'For the Lord and for Gideon!'

declarations.text: God uses me mightily despite my past.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Jephthah went over to fight the Ammonites, and the Lord gave them into his hands.

declarations.text: My strength is renewed by God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But his hair began to grow again after it had been shaved.

declarations.text: God raises me as a deliverer.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.

declarations.text: Victory belongs to the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A sword for the Lord and for Gideon!

declarations.text: My loyalty is rewarded abundantly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord repay you for what you have done. May you be richly rewarded by the Lord.

declarations.text: God grants me unexpected favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you notice me a foreigner? Boaz replied, 'I've been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband. May the Lord repay you for what you have done. May you be richly rewarded by the Lord, the God of Israel.'

declarations.text: God restores my emptiness to fullness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I went away full, but the Lord has brought me back empty. The women said to Naomi: 'Praise be to the Lord, who has not left you without a guardian-redeemer.'

declarations.text: My redeemer covers me with his protection.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a guardian-redeemer of our family.

declarations.text: Where God leads, I follow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.

declarations.text: I glean in fields of divine favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So she went out, entered a field and began to glean behind the harvesters. As it turned out, she was working in a field belonging to Boaz.

declarations.text: My latter days are greater than my beginning.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The women living there said, 'Naomi has a son!' And they named him Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.

declarations.text: I am worth more than seven sons.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.

declarations.text: God orchestrates divine appointments for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters.

declarations.text: I rest under the wings of the Almighty.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May you be richly rewarded by the Lord, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.

declarations.text: The Lord hears my prayers.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I prayed for this child, and the Lord has granted me what I asked of him.

declarations.text: My heart rejoices in the Lord's salvation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My heart rejoices in the Lord; in the Lord my horn is lifted high.

declarations.text: The Lord raises me from dust to throne.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord sends poverty and wealth; he humbles and he exalts. He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap; he seats them with princes.

declarations.text: The Lord calls me by name.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord came and stood there, calling as at the other times, 'Samuel! Samuel!'

declarations.text: I see what God sees, not man.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

declarations.text: God's Spirit comes powerfully upon me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and from that day on the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon David.

declarations.text: I defeat giants with God's name.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty.

declarations.text: The battle belongs to the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: All those gathered here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the Lord saves; for the battle is the Lord's.

declarations.text: God delivers me from all my enemies.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord who rescued me from the paw of the lion and the paw of the bear will rescue me from the hand of this Philistine.

declarations.text: My covenant with God stands forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.

declarations.text: I find strength in the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: David found strength in the Lord his God.

declarations.text: To obey is better than sacrifice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.

declarations.text: The Lord trains my hands for spiritual battle.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise be to the Lord my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle. He is my loving God and my fortress.

declarations.text: The Lord is my rock and fortress.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge.

declarations.text: God makes my way perfect.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As for God, his way is perfect: The Lord's word is flawless; he shields all who take refuge in him.

declarations.text: I am anointed king over God's people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord, and they anointed David king over Israel.

declarations.text: The Lord gives me rest from enemies.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord had given him rest from all his enemies around him.

declarations.text: God's covenant with me is everlasting.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me; your throne will be established forever.

declarations.text: The Spirit of the Lord speaks through me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.

declarations.text: God brings me out into a spacious place.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

declarations.text: The Lord thunders from heaven for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded amid hailstones and bolts of lightning.

declarations.text: I am exalted above my foes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You exalted me above my foes; from a violent man you rescued me.

declarations.text: God gives me wisdom abundantly when I ask.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So God said to him, 'Since you have asked for this and not for long life or wealth for yourself, nor have asked for the death of your enemies but for discernment in administering justice, I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart.'

declarations.text: God gives me wisdom and understanding beyond measure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.

declarations.text: The Lord appears to me and speaks.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord appeared to him at night and said: 'I have heard the prayer and plea you have made before me.'

declarations.text: Fire falls from heaven at my prayer.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the fire of the Lord fell and burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones and the soil, and also licked up the water in the trench.

declarations.text: The Lord is God!
declarations.bibleVerseText: When all the people saw this, they fell prostrate and cried, 'The Lord he is God! The Lord he is God!'

declarations.text: Ravens feed me by God's command.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening.

declarations.text: My jar of oil never runs dry.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The jar of flour was not used up and the jug of oil did not run dry, in keeping with the word of the Lord.

declarations.text: God speaks in a gentle whisper.
declarations.bibleVerseText: After the earthquake came a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper.

declarations.text: I build a house for God's name.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have indeed built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever.

declarations.text: God's glory fills my temple.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When the priests withdrew from the Holy Place, the cloud filled the temple of the Lord.

declarations.text: Not one word of God's promises fails.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Not one word has failed of all the good promises he gave through his servant Moses.

declarations.text: I run in the strength of God's food.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Strengthened by that food, he traveled forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb.

declarations.text: I receive a double portion of God's spirit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let me inherit a double portion of your spirit.

declarations.text: God heals every bitter situation in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then he said, 'This is what the Lord says: I have healed this water. Never again will it cause death or make the land unproductive.'

declarations.text: God multiplies my resources miraculously.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Elisha said, 'Go around and ask all your neighbors for empty jars. Don't ask for just a few. Then go inside and shut the door behind you and your sons. Pour oil into all the jars, and as each is filled, put it to one side.' She left him and shut the door behind her and her sons. They brought the jars to her and she kept pouring.

declarations.text: The dead are raised at my word.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.

declarations.text: My leprosy is cleansed in the waters.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So he went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, and his flesh was restored.

declarations.text: God does the impossible in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The man of God asked, 'Where did it fall?' When he showed him the place, Elisha cut a stick and threw it there, and made the iron float.

declarations.text: Those with me are more than those against.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who are with us are more than those who are with them.

declarations.text: My eyes are opened to see heaven's armies.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then the Lord opened the servant's eyes, and he looked and saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire.

declarations.text: One angel defeats entire armies for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That night the angel of the Lord went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp.

declarations.text: God controls time and seasons for my benefit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Isaiah said, 'This is the Lord's sign to you that the Lord will do what he has promised.' Then the shadow went back the ten steps it had gone down.

declarations.text: I inquire of God and He answers.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So David inquired of God, and God answered him.

declarations.text: The Lord breaks out against my enemies.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So David and his men went up to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, 'As waters break out, God has broken out against my enemies.'

declarations.text: My fame spreads throughout every land.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So David's fame spread throughout every land, and the Lord made all the nations fear him.

declarations.text: I bring the ark with rejoicing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: David and all the Israelites were celebrating with all their might before God, with songs and with harps.

declarations.text: Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give praise to the Lord, proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

declarations.text: The Lord reigns forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord reigns forever; your God, O Zion, for all generations.

declarations.text: I offer willingly with a whole. heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I know, my God, that you test the heart and are pleased with integrity. All these things I have given willingly and with a whole heart.

declarations.text: Riches and honor come from God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wealth and honor come from you; you are the ruler of all things.

declarations.text: In God's hand is power and might.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In your hands are strength and power to exalt and give strength to all.

declarations.text: I prepare abundantly for God's house.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have taken great pains to provide for the temple of the Lord.

declarations.text: When I humble myself and pray, God heals.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.

declarations.text: The Lord's eyes and heart are always with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord appeared to him at night and said: 'I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a temple for sacrifices. Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.'

declarations.text: The battle is not mine but God's.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army. For the battle is not yours, but God's.

declarations.text: I stand still and see God's salvation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will not have to fight this battle. Take up your positions; stand firm and see the deliverance the Lord will give you.

declarations.text: I lead with praise and enemies fall.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As they began to sing and praise, the Lord set ambushes against the men who were invading Judah, and they were defeated.

declarations.text: God's eyes range throughout earth to strengthen me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the eyes of the Lord range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him.

declarations.text: I seek the Lord and He is found.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But if from there you seek the Lord your God, you will find him if you seek him with all your heart.

declarations.text: God is with me when I am with Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is with you when you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you.

declarations.text: My work is rewarded by God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be strong and do not give up, for your work will be rewarded.

declarations.text: I rely on the Lord my God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lord, there is no one like you to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, Lord our God, for we rely on you.

declarations.text: The Lord moves hearts to fulfill His purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation.

declarations.text: God's good hand is upon me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because the hand of the Lord my God was on me, I took courage.

declarations.text: I set my heart to study and do God's law.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord, and to teaching its decrees.

declarations.text: God grants me favor with kings.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise be to the Lord, the God of our ancestors, who has put it into the king's heart.

declarations.text: I rebuild what was destroyed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then they gave money to the masons and carpenters, and gave food and drink and olive oil to the people.

declarations.text: Great joy fills my restoration.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And all the people gave a great shout of praise to the Lord, because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.

declarations.text: I separate myself unto holiness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Separate yourselves from the peoples around you and from your foreign wives.

declarations.text: The Lord's steadfast love endures forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With praise and thanksgiving they sang to the Lord: 'He is good; his love toward Israel endures forever.'

declarations.text: I trust God with all my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

declarations.text: The Lord makes my paths straight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

declarations.text: God's wisdom is my principal treasure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

declarations.text: The Lord orders every step of my path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

declarations.text: My heart overflows with God's life and power.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

declarations.text: My life shines brighter and brighter with God's glory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

declarations.text: Everything. I commit to God prospers and succeeds.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

declarations.text: My gentle words bring peace and healing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

declarations.text: Honoring God extends my life and blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

declarations.text: I am worth far more than rubies.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

declarations.text: Wisdom and truth flow from my mouth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools are not upright.

declarations.text: My relationships make me sharper and stronger.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

declarations.text: God makes my plans succeed beyond my dreams.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails.

declarations.text: God's favor on my life is worth more than riches.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

declarations.text: God prospers the work of my hands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.

declarations.text: God's blessing brings wealth without sorrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: My words carry the power of life and death.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

declarations.text: I bring honor and blessing to my family.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

declarations.text: I face the future with joy and confidence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

declarations.text: My family sees God's blessing in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.

declarations.text: God fills me with His wisdom and understanding.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver.

declarations.text: God's righteousness protects my path.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Righteousness guards the person of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

declarations.text: God's wisdom builds my life and legacy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established; through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

declarations.text: I raise my children to walk with God forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.

declarations.text: My humility brings honor and blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall. Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.

declarations.text: I live by every word from God's mouth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.

declarations.text: Christ makes me salt and light of the world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden. Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house. In the same way, let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

declarations.text: I seek God's kingdom and He provides all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

declarations.text: I ask and receive, seek and find.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

declarations.text: My faith moves mountains.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move.

declarations.text: All authority in heaven and earth backs me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Then Jesus came to them and said, 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.'

declarations.text: Jesus is with me always.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.

declarations.text: I am blessed when persecuted for righteousness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

declarations.text: My Father knows what I need.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your Father knows what you need before you ask him.

declarations.text: I build my house on the rock.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

declarations.text: Nothing is impossible for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With God all things are possible.

declarations.text: I take His yoke - it's easy and light.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

declarations.text: Whatever. I bind on earth is bound in heaven.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

declarations.text: Where two or three gather, He is there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.

declarations.text: I receive a hundredfold return.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for my sake will receive a hundred times as much.

declarations.text: With God, all things are possible when I believe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: 'If you can?' said Jesus. 'Everything is possible for one who believes.' Immediately the boy's father exclaimed, 'I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!'

declarations.text: I speak to mountains and they move.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Have faith in God. Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, 'Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.

declarations.text: God answers when I pray with faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

declarations.text: Signs follow me as I believe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues.

declarations.text: I lay hands on the sick and they recover.
declarations.bibleVerseText: They will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well.

declarations.text: The kingdom of God is within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!

declarations.text: I am not ashamed of Jesus.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father's glory with the holy angels.

declarations.text: New wine flows in my new wineskin.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.

declarations.text: With God, nothing is impossible.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God.

declarations.text: Peace, be still - storms obey.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, 'Quiet! Be still!' Then the wind died down.

declarations.text: Nothing is impossible with God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For no word from God will ever fail.

declarations.text: The power of the Most High overshadows me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the holy one to be born will be called the Son of God.

declarations.text: My spirit rejoices in God my Savior.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My soul glorifies the Lord and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior.

declarations.text: The Lord has done great things for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Mighty One has done great things for me holy is his name.

declarations.text: I am blessed because I believe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!

declarations.text: Give, and it is given to me abundantly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over.

declarations.text: I have authority to tread on serpents.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy.

declarations.text: My name is written in heaven.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

declarations.text: The kingdom of God is within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The kingdom of God is in your midst.

declarations.text: I am faithful with little, ruler over much.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever is faithful in very little is also faithful in much.

declarations.text: I bear much fruit as His disciple.
declarations.bibleVerseText: This is to my Father's glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

declarations.text: Greater is He that is in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.

declarations.text: I have eternal life through believing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

declarations.text: I am born of the Spirit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.

declarations.text: Jesus' truth sets me completely free.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Jesus said, 'If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples. Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.'

declarations.text: I have life more abundantly.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

declarations.text: Rivers of living water flow from me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.

declarations.text: I do greater works than Jesus did.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things.
